entry.content: 4chan bandwidth was 3PB last month. 4chan doesn’t use amazon web services. But you can guess the price with it. $0.030 per GB 1000GB = 1TB 1000TB = 1PB $0.03 x 3,000,000(3PB) = $90,000 3PB is $90,000 per month by amazon web service. https://aws.amazon.com/cloudfront/pricing/
